leftEvidence.title: Barnabas brings Saul to the apostles

points.label: People encountered
points.left: Barnabas brings Saul to the apostles. Acts 9:26–31 belongs to Encounter and first witness.
points.right: Paul meets Cephas and James while Judea hears of change. Galatians 1:18–24 belongs to Freedom, unity, and imprisonment letters.

points.label: Time and movement
points.left: Barnabas brings Saul to the apostles. When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple. So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
points.right: Paul meets Cephas and James while Judea hears of change. Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days. So they glorified God in me.

payload.posture: Inspect what each source actually says before relating their chronology, argument, or remembered scene.
